sections.title: Letter elle
paragraphs: The letter name is (elle) /ˈɛlle/. It makes the sound in (luna) /ˈlu.na/, which means moon. This letter has only one sound.

sections.title: Pronouncing elle
paragraphs: Place the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Let the air flow smoothly around the sides of your tongue. Turn on your voice. A voiced sound makes your throat shake. Touch your throat to feel the vibration.

sections.title: Spelling and reading
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound in (luna) /ˈlu.na/ in all standard positions. You hear the exact same sound in (sole) /ˈso.le/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make a dark sound by pulling the back of your tongue down. Avoid the muffled end sound of the English word ball. Keep the back of your tongue low and flat. Keep the tip firmly on the ridge behind your upper teeth, like in light.
